# Algebraic_Emergence

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
The derivation of coarse-grained effective theories from the algebraic structure of neural circuit interactions rather than from detailed biophysical parameters. It enables topology-centric abstraction of biological neuronal networks for scalable TCC models.
